angularDiameterSource: Montargès et al. (2018, A&A 614, A12): power-law limb-darkened disc diameter 10.18 +/- 0.07 mas at 1.62 um for the December 2016 dataset (10.09 +/- 0.09 mas in November), first two lobes only. Cruzalèbes et al. (2013) give 9.97 mas in the K band.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.5207 +/- 0.2661 mas (Gaia Collaboration 2020, yCat I/350, via SIMBAD): 658 pc. Montargès et al. (2018) adopt the Hipparcos 1.82 +/- 0.26 mas (549 pc), which gives 587-593 solar radii.
radiusSource: The December limb-darkened diameter at the Gaia distance: 10.18 mas at 657.6 pc is 500,725,430 km, 720 solar radii at 695700 km; at the Hipparcos distance the same diameter is 601 solar radii.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 3801 ± 134 K from Montargès et al. 2018 (A&A 614, A12; https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/201731471), Section 4.1: the PIONIER limb-darkened diameter of December 2016, the epoch of the package's diameter, with the bolometric flux. The paper gives 3820 ± 135 K for November 2016.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the fitted radius. The photosphere of a red supergiant is not a solid surface and its limb is not sharp; the sphere is the reference surface the published images are cast onto, not a measured shape.
